notes.text: The named William Davidson Chullin 75b paragraph writes Ada bar Chavu without a title, while the Yoma 87a paragraph explicitly writes Rav Yosef bar Chavu. These are Hyman’s two separate lexical pointers under Chavu; the shared patronymic does not establish a single father or bind either name to an authority. No additional events or legal rulings from either paragraph are included.
